name: Being Weary
overview: Scripture reveals that God, the everlasting Creator, never grows weary or faint, offering a source of unending strength to those who wait upon Him. Believers are invited to come to Christ, who promises rest for the weary and heavy laden, assuring that by taking His yoke and learning from His meek and lowly heart, they will find renewed strength and soul-refreshing rest. The Lord also assures His people of His thoughtful plans for their peace and ultimate hope, and He personally satisfies and replenishes the weary and sorrowful soul.
